claims.claim: At exponential tilting coefficient -25, the finetuned CtRL-Sim model generates 2.1x as many collisions as the base CtRL-Sim model.
claims.metric: collision rate ratio (finetuned vs base) at tilting -25
claims.condition: tilting coefficient -25; CtRL-Sim FT (base finetuned on CAT-generated collision scenes) vs base; 1 selected interesting agent controlled, 1000 random test scenes, 1 s history, 8 s rollout, 5 seeds; reward dimension per Figure 4 not named in this sentence
claims.comparison: CtRL-Sim base model at the same -25 tilting
claims.quote:
Specifically, at -25 tilting,
the finetuned model is able to generate 2.1× as many collisions and 1.8× as many offroad violations
as the base model.

claims.claim: CtRL-Sim (Base), without tilting, has a collision rate of 5.8 +/- 0.4 percent in multi-agent imitation.
claims.condition: Table 1 multi-agent imitation, Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 1000 test scenes, up to 8 moving agents controlled by CtRL-Sim, 1 s history, 8 s rollout, mean+/-std over 5 seeds, base model without tilting

claims.claim: CtRL-Sim (Positive Tilting), with tilting coefficient 10 applied to all reward components, has a collision rate of 5.3 +/- 0.2 percent.
claims.condition: Table 1 multi-agent imitation, Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 1000 test scenes, up to 8 moving agents controlled, 1 s history, 8 s rollout, 5 seeds; kappa_c = 10 on all components of the base model

claims.claim: CtRL-Sim (Base), without tilting, has an off-road rate of 11.8 +/- 0.2 percent in multi-agent imitation.
claims.condition: Table 1 multi-agent imitation, Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 1000 test scenes, up to 8 moving agents controlled, 1 s history, 8 s rollout, 5 seeds, base model without tilting

claims.claim: CtRL-Sim (Positive Tilting), with tilting coefficient 10 on all reward components, has an off-road rate of 11.0 +/- 0.2 percent.
claims.condition: Table 1 multi-agent imitation, Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 1000 test scenes, up to 8 moving agents controlled, 1 s history, 8 s rollout, 5 seeds; kappa_c = 10 on all components of the base model
